name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-github-enterprise
description: Govern GitHub Enterprise orgs, repos, rulesets, security alerts & Actions for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: GHE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token (fine-grained PAT, classic PAT, or App installation token). Read-only scopes to start.

environmentVariables.name: GHE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Cloud: https://api.github.com (default). Server/GHES: https://HOST/api/v3.

environmentVariables.name: GHE_ENTERPRISE
environmentVariables.description: Enterprise slug, for enterprise-level endpoints (audit log, Actions policy). Optional.

environmentVariables.name: GHE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Start with read-only.
